feed.title: Huntbase Hub
feed.subtitle: Open hunt playbooks drafted from current threat research and reviewed by a person. Read each one, take the hunt.md file, or run it in Huntbase.

entry.title: M365 Identity Takeover and Application Abuse
entry.summary: An attacker has hijacked an M365 session via device-code flow or token theft, modified MFA for persistence, and abused over-permissioned applications to escalate to Global Administrator.

entry.title: Endpoint PowerShell Execution via Social Engineering
entry.summary: An attacker has tricked a user into running a malicious PowerShell command via the Windows Run dialog by mimicking a CAPTCHA on a look-alike SharePoint site to exfiltrate session tokens.

entry.title: AI Agent Manipulation and Data Exfiltration
entry.summary: An adversary has delivered a prompt-injection email that manipulated a cloud-hosted AI agent into collecting sensitive SharePoint documents and exfiltrating them via outbound email.

entry.title: VMware vCenter Directory Service Authentication Bypass Exposure
entry.summary: An unauthenticated attacker is attempting to exploit a critical authentication bypass in the VMware Directory Service (vmdir) by sending malicious LDAP or RPC traffic to exposed vCenter instances.

entry.title: Agentic Execution and Persistence Timing
entry.summary: Autonomous agents are operating on web-facing infrastructure, identified by rapid reasoning bursts in process telemetry and high-speed iterative HTTP status transitions during web shell deployment.

entry.title: Improvised Swarm Infrastructure and Coordination
entry.summary: An adversary is using a multi-agent swarm that coordinates tasks through public web services and self-labeling URL parameters, avoiding dedicated infrastructure to bypass traditional network detections.

entry.title: Agentic Swarm Access and Improvised C2
entry.summary: Autonomous agentic swarms have compromised public-facing web or management servers and are using improvised web services or blockchain memos for machine-speed coordination and data exfiltration.

entry.title: Autonomous Swarm Endpoint Operations
entry.summary: An autonomous agentic swarm is executing on endpoints, characterized by high-speed sub-second process bursts and predictable state-tracking file names like artex-probe.

entry.title: ARTEX Agentic AI Framework Exploitation
entry.summary: An adversary is using an agentic AI framework to automate cloud privilege escalation and exfiltration, evidenced by rapid Global Administrator role assignments followed by automated recon tool execution and data staging to web services.

entry.title: Machine-Speed Agent Tooling and Credential Harvesting
entry.summary: An automated agent is performing high-frequency tool execution to conduct reconnaissance and dump credentials from sensitive files like .env or /etc/shadow at machine speeds.

entry.title: ARTEX AI-Driven Perimeter Recon and Identity Probing
entry.summary: An autonomous AI-powered framework is conducting high-speed perimeter scanning and identity pressure, transitioning from credential sprays to sensitive configuration discovery at machine speed.

entry.title: ClickFix Post-Exploitation and Payloads
entry.summary: An adversary has established a beachhead via a ClickFix lure and is now using the finger.exe utility for command-and-control while deploying sideloaded DLLs and infostealers within user-writable directories.

entry.title: ClickFix Paste-and-Run Execution and Persistence
entry.summary: An intruder has tricked a user into pasting a malicious command into the Windows Run box, causing explorer.exe to spawn an obfuscated shell that establishes persistence via scheduled tasks or Run keys.

entry.title: vCenter Appliance Administrative Tampering and Root Access
entry.summary: An attacker is established on a vCenter appliance and is using administrative APIs to create local persistence and enable restricted shells for root-level command execution.

entry.title: vCenter Directory Service Exploitation and Credential Theft
entry.summary: An attacker is exploiting CVE-2026-123890 to bypass vCenter authentication on TCP 2012, aiming to exfiltrate the directory database and steal the STS signing key.

entry.title: NGINX HTTP/2 Use-After-Free Exploitation and Impact
entry.summary: An adversary exploits CVE-2026-123633 by sending fragmented HTTP/2 requests to a vulnerable NGINX instance, triggering a use-after-free during request-time DNS resolution that causes worker crashes or remote code execution.

entry.title: Agentic AI Autonomous Behavioral Patterns
entry.summary: An autonomous AI agent is conducting an intrusion, evidenced by inhuman command velocity, structured section headers in shell output, and chain-of-thought reasoning comments within script telemetry.

entry.title: Malicious AI Agent and MCP Server Host Activity
entry.summary: An intruder has compromised a developer workstation through a malicious MCP server or AI extension, using it to bypass safety checks, access local credentials, and establish persistence via OS-level startup mechanisms.

entry.title: Cross-Plane Ransomware and AI Exploitation
entry.summary: An adversary has exploited a public-facing application to harvest cloud credentials, used them to abuse cloud-hosted AI services, and eventually deployed ransomware on associated Linux systems.

entry.title: GenAI Agent Prompt Injection and Tool Hijacking
entry.summary: An adversary is manipulating GenAI agent behavior through natural language prompt injection or encoded payloads to bypass guardrails and execute unauthorized tool calls or API operations.

entry.title: Compromised IoT Network Activity
entry.summary: End-of-life IoT devices have been conscripted into botnets or hijacked for traffic redirection, evidenced by anomalous DNS failure patterns, internal lateral probing, or HTTP connections to phishing infrastructure.

entry.title: Exposed IoT Posture and Operational Impact
entry.summary: An adversary has exploited unpatched vulnerabilities in end-of-life IoT devices, evidenced by rare process execution on identified smart hardware, unauthorized external exposure of management ports, and failing states in the IoT control plane.

entry.title: Email Infrastructure Compromise and Impersonation
entry.summary: An adversary has exploited vulnerabilities in Zimbra, Cisco Secure Email Gateway, or BeyondTrust to achieve remote code execution and persistent access through script overwrites and identity boundary bypasses.

entry.title: VMware vCenter Authentication Bypass (CVE-2026-123890)
entry.summary: An adversary has exploited a critical authentication bypass in the VMware Directory Service (vmdir) to gain unauthorized administrative access to vCenter, likely originating from an external or anomalous source IP.

entry.title: OpenShift Compliance Drift and Audit Correlation
entry.summary: Unauthorized changes to OpenShift resources such as pods or service accounts trigger compliance violations that the hunt traces to a specific actor by correlating scan failures with Kubernetes API audit logs.

entry.title: Rebranded SoftEther VPN Tunneling
entry.summary: An intruder has established a persistent, covert tunnel by deploying a customized SoftEther VPN bridge that masquerades as legitimate network monitor software using modified PE metadata and encrypted configuration files.

entry.title: Unauthenticated MS-SNTP RID Sweeping
entry.summary: An adversary is performing unauthenticated MS-SNTP RID sweeping against Domain Controllers to harvest password-derived MACs, often preceded by a configuration downgrade to allow legacy MD5 authenticators.

entry.title: ASR Near-Misses: Blocked Attempts and the Route Around Them
entry.summary: An intruder triggered a Defender attack surface reduction rule, such as LSASS credential theft, an Office child process or PsExec/WMI process creation, and then reached the same objective by a route the rule does not cover; or the rule was only auditing and the action went ahead.

entry.title: Processes Defender Scored but Never Alerted On
entry.summary: An intruder's tooling on a Windows host performed credential access, injection, persistence or defence-evasion behaviour that Microsoft Defender attributed to the process as ATT&CK techniques, but stayed below the threshold for a detection, so nothing reached Protection History or the SIEM.

entry.title: After Defender Remediates: What Changed and Where Else It Is
entry.summary: Malware that Microsoft Defender remediated on one host also reached other hosts where Defender did not detect it or where the attacker deleted it first, and its persistence and file hashes are recoverable from Defender's remediation and hash caches.

entry.title: Unsigned Payloads and DLL Side-Loading Tagged by Defender
entry.summary: A loader delivered through a browser download, archive or messaging app wrote an unsigned executable, or a DLL beside a signed program, into a user-writable folder and ran it, and Defender tagged the file without raising a detection.

entry.title: Defender Weakening: Tamper Protection, ASR Rules and Exclusions
entry.summary: An operator with administrative rights on a Windows host has weakened Microsoft Defender before running tooling or ransomware: Tamper Protection off, ASR rules moved to audit or off, scan exclusions added, or the engine stopped, on one host rather than through fleet policy.

entry.title: Agent-Framework Exfiltration to Webhook.site
entry.summary: An intruder is exfiltrating harvested cloud and developer credentials from Python runtimes to a malicious webhook.site endpoint following the agent-framework PyPI compromise.

entry.title: Malicious Python Package Persistence and Secret Theft
entry.summary: An intruder has installed a compromised version of the agent-framework package which persists via a .pth hook and harvests cloud credentials by reading environment variables from the /proc filesystem and local configuration files.

entry.title: AI Runtime Post-Exploitation and Compute Theft
entry.summary: An intruder has exploited an unauthenticated AI runtime to access system credentials via path traversal or hijacked cloud model subscriptions, evidenced by sensitive file access and unauthorized cloud API calls for premium models.

entry.title: Exposed AI Runtime Probing and Callbacks
entry.summary: An adversary is identifying unauthenticated AI runtimes exposed to the internet and using them to verify connectivity or establish command-and-control via outbound tunneling services.

entry.title: Overlord RAT Exploitation and Data Encryption
entry.summary: An adversary exploits a public-facing application to deploy the Overlord RAT and then encrypts data, bypassing traditional network blocks by resolving C2 coordinates via blockchain transactions.

entry.title: Decentralized Blockchain C2 Resolution
entry.summary: An adversary is using public blockchain ledgers as dead-drop resolvers for C2 configuration, identified by outbound RPC calls to node providers followed by rare network beaconing to resolved endpoints.

entry.title: NGINX HTTP/2 Integer Underflow and RCE
entry.summary: An adversary is exploiting a critical integer underflow in NGINX's HTTP/2 flow control by transmitting a high-volume data flood to corrupt memory and execute code within the NGINX worker process context.

entry.title: UAT-12643 Stager Abuse and Registry Persistence
entry.summary: An adversary is using signed Windows binaries to stage payloads on hosts running targeted software, establishing persistence through masqueraded Edge updater binaries in user-writable paths.

entry.title: Optimizely Injected Script: Visitor, Session and Site-Owner Exposure
entry.summary: Staff browsers that visited a site carrying the tampered Optimizely snippet on 16 Nov 2026 loaded the attacker's script, and some sent card details, readable cookies or iPhone traffic to the attacker; separately, the organisation's own Optimizely project may have served the script to its customers.

entry.title: OPTIMJACK Third-Party Script Supply Chain Impact
entry.summary: An adversary has exploited a trusted third-party vendor to distribute malicious JavaScript via their CDN, leading to mobile exploit delivery and credential skimming on internal corporate assets.

entry.title: PHP Unauthenticated RCE Exploitation
entry.summary: An adversary is exploiting unauthenticated RCE in PHP (CVE-2026-109618/19) by delivering crafted multipart requests that trigger memory corruption or stale-state access, confirmed by worker crashes and rare child processes.

entry.title: Langflow Host Impact and Persistence
entry.summary: An attacker has exploited a code-injection vulnerability in Langflow to execute arbitrary Python code, resulting in interactive shell access and persistence through unauthorized modifications to the application database.

entry.title: Langflow RCE and Cloud Metadata Discovery
entry.summary: An attacker is exploiting unauthenticated remote code execution vulnerabilities in Langflow AI endpoints and subsequently querying the cloud metadata service to harvest identity tokens for lateral movement.

entry.title: Brotli Decoder Exposure and Exploitation Assessment
entry.summary: An attacker is exploiting a vulnerable Brotli decoder (CVE-2026-111497) in an internet-facing Node.js or proxy instance to gain remote code execution or cause memory-corrupting crashes.

entry.title: BeyondTrust Remote Support Unauthenticated Exploitation and RCE
entry.summary: An intruder has exploited CVE-2026-102764 on a BeyondTrust Remote Support appliance by forging internal message origins to upload and execute a PHP payload.

entry.title: BOD 26-04 Critical Vulnerability Triage
entry.summary: An attacker has exploited a publicly exposed, KEV-listed application (SharePoint, PAN-OS, or N-central) before remediation, establishing initial access or executing code with high privileges.

entry.title: AI Coding Agent Device Code Hijacking
entry.summary: An attacker has hijacked an AI coding agent by phishing a device code from a developer, obtaining an OAuth token to steer local terminal sessions and exfiltrate private repository data.

entry.title: Outlook Silent NTLM Credential Leakage
entry.summary: An attacker is exploiting CVE-2026-124194 by forcing Outlook to initiate outbound SMB connections to an external listener, silently leaking the user's NTLM v2 hash upon opening a crafted file.
